title: Large-Scale, Automated Production of Adipose-Derived Stem Cell Spheroids for 3D Bioprinting
protocol: Open the tissue culture 175 cm² flask containing the monolayer of ASCs at 80% confluence and discard the supernatant.
Add 7 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS, 0.01 M) and wash the monolayer twice.
Discard the liquid.
Add 5 mL of 0.125% trypsin with 0.78 mM EDTA to the flask.
Incubate for 5 min at 37 °C.
Add 10 mL of low-glucose Dulbecco's Modified Eagle Medium (DMEM LOW) with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Mix the cell suspension well with a 10 mL serological pipette.
Harvest the cell suspension with a 10 mL serological pipette and transfer it to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min to obtain the pellet of ASCs.
Resuspend the cell pellet using DMEM LOW containing 10% FBS.
Perform a cell count by trypan exclusion.
Prepare 50 mL of sterile solution of 2% ultrapure agarose in 0.9% NaCl in ultrapure water.
Autoclave the agarose solution for 30 min at 121 °C.
Add 500 µL of sterile 2% ultrapure agarose solution to the center of a silicone mold containing 81 or 256 circular recesses.
Unmold the ultrapure agarose from the silicone mold after 40 min and place it in a well of a 12-well plastic plate.
Add 2 mL of DMEM LOW into the well with the micromolded agarose.
Incubate the well at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 atmosphere for at least 12 h before seeding ASCs.
Check whether laminar flow is on and the airflow cabinet works properly.
Check if equipment is connected to correct voltage.
Ensure tablet is connected to the equipment.
Adjust cabinet protection glass height to match sensor marking of the equipment.
Press On/Off button on left side of equipment and wait for start-up.
Position the tip boxes in the workspace of the equipment.
Position the rack for centrifuge tubes in the workspace of the equipment.
Position the plate containing the micromolded agarose hydrogel in the workspace of the equipment.
Open Labware Editor on the software at the tablet.
Set up a virtual worktable representing physical positions of accessories.
Choose positions of pipettes, tip boxes, rack for plastic tubes, and plates.
Click on Switch to Produce button to include parameters and commands.
Wait for toolbar and Produce List to open in the software.
Enter number of samples to be pipetted into the Produce List.
Drag the number of samples to the Produce List.
Click on Sample Transfer command button on the software.
Transfer ASC suspension from plastic centrifuge tubes to micromolds in 12-well plate.
Set up start and end positions for equipment to transfer sample.
Wait for the software to return to the Work Table page.
Click on the Options button to set up automated seeding parameters.
Set Aspiration Speed to 15.4 s-1, Dispense Speed to 1 s-1, Blow Delay to 0 ms, Blow Speed to 15.4 s-1, and Initial Stroke to 100%.
Select Water as the Standard Liquid Type.
Set mixing parameters for ASCs: Number of Cycles at 5, Speed at 6.5 s-1, Volume at 300 µL.
Add Time of 40 min to the Produce List for decanting ASC suspension.
Include Reagent Transfer option in the Produce List to transfer spheroid culture medium to wells.
Set up position and parameter configurations to transfer spheroid culture medium again.
Click on the button with a check symbol to ensure no programming error exists.
Click on the Play button (triangle symbol) to start the program.
Wait for equipment sound indicating completion of programmed tasks.
Collect the 12-well plate and incubate it in an incubator at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for at least 18 h.
Manually harvest the spheroids after 1, 3, and 7 days of culture for analysis.
Flush the medium with a micropipette to liberate the spheroids from the micromolded non-adherent agarose hydrogel.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Check under the microscope to determine if the spheroids are completely released from the hydrogel.
Collect the spheroids manually using a micropipette and transfer them to a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash the spheroids at least two times with 0.01 M PBS.
Assess the viability of the spheroids.
Perform biomechanical analyses on the fresh spheroid samples.
Incubate the spheroid samples in 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS for at least 18 h at 2-8 °C for morphology analysis (histology).
